The artifact remains CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED, binds NOTHING, and carries DO-NOT-SEAL on its own terms. decision.summaryForCoordinator: Both named states were tested as exact substrings of live G25 v2's exactByteIntent rather than judged for plausibility, and both match to the character. The only divergence is that the second stops before the live parenthetical '(v2 inputVerbatim)', which records where the sentence came from rather than describing the state — nothing substantive dropped, nothing added. The cell ids are == live in order, and both states carry the single live memberVerbatim, so the artifact holds the one-class-two-cells shape in both directions: it neither collapses the readings into one state nor splits the class into two. One count needed resolving to the character. A literal sweep finds 18 'NT-' against 17 'NT-3', which reads as a stray identifier — and on this gate a second NT number would be the clearest sign of borrowing, since DR-133 owns its own NT-3 and NT-5 at G23. The eighteenth hit is inside 'AWAITING-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW'. Matching NT- followed by a digit gives 17, all NT-3, and DR-133 is not mentioned at all. The G23 and G27 attributions are quoted rather than assigned: live G25 v2's retainedEvidence says 'Unknown-to-covered conversion is G23, not this member' and 'sealed-Run labelling is G27 and is not retained here', which is exactly how the subject pairs them. Its disclaimer is narrower than the harness's six-gate version, and the narrowing hides nothing — G24, G26, G28 and G30 appear nowhere in the file, so there is no surface to disclaim. Two structural notes. This subject cites no named-corpus catalog, unlike its three sibling input corpora; I verified none exists for G25, so nothing is fabricated, and it compensates with a per-state source field naming the live cell each state derives from. And DR-131's live row carries SATISFIED text in its blocker cell — a genuine import hazard that required explicit checking on the g25 leftover-join — but the input-corpus shape carries no file08StatusToken at all, removing the failure mode rather than answering it. All five cited digests match, both fixtureBytes read NOT-AUTHORED with no digest or path anywhere in initialStates, the gate join re-measures with OBL-G25-FX-AUTHORING true and ntReadingsCollapsed false, the bare-integer set is 1 and 26, and the subject did not move. Twenty-three attacks run, twenty-three refuted, zero findings. A disclosure that bears on weight: the two NT-3 cells exist because I rejected G25 harness v1 at CLAUDE-G25-V1-B1 for having no NT-3 corpus class; v2 added them, I accepted v2, I accepted g25-leftover-join.v1 earlier in this session, and this subject pins that verdict. Three artifacts now rest on a structure I asked for and I have now judged compliance with it three times — so I re-derived every cell, the exactByteIntent text and both gate attributions from live harness bytes, and tested the states by substring rather than by whether they looked right.
